headlines.title: House Democrats select Jeffries as leader, setting him up as the first Black speaker
headlines.description: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries of New York won his party’s nomination for speaker of the House, putting him on a glide path for election to the top job on the first day of the new Congress in January.

headlines.title: Elon Musk says he is ‘not MAGA’ after spending millions on Trump and his allies
headlines.description: Elon Musk struck a more moderate tone while discussing his political affiliation Wednesday, arguing that he does not have “blind adherence” to the policies of the Republican Party or MAGA.

headlines.title: What to expect from Trump's meeting with Putin and Xi Jinping
headlines.description: NBC News' Janis Mackey Frayer and Gabe Gutierrez go over what to potentially expect from President Trump's meeting with President Putin and President Xi Jinping during the APEC summit and what each country may ask for.

headlines.title: Elon Musk says he feels 'foolish' after spending hundreds of millions backing Republicans
headlines.description: Elon Musk told the New York Times in a video interview at the Dealbook Summit that he feels "foolish" after spending nearly half a billion dollars backing Republicans in the midterm elections. As a new crop of Democrats prepare to enter Congress, some are talking about opening investigations into the Tesla CEO over his involvement in DOGE.

headlines.title: Trump set for historic summit with Putin, Xi
headlines.description: China rolled out the red carpet for President Trump ahead of his historic meeting with the leaders of China and Russia. NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas reports.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Sen. Elissa Slotkin fires back at DOJ official over investigation of her political speech
headlines.description: U.S. Attorney Aaron Reitz has suggested that Slotkin’s comments about congressional oversight could amount to a criminal civil rights offense.

headlines.title: High school valedictorians to get Nike shoes after request from Mississippi’s incoming senator
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Scott Colom’s taste in footwear may have just added a new incentive for high school seniors to keep up their grades.

headlines.title: Russian man accused of spying targeted Palantir workers, sources say
headlines.description: Igor D’iu bought laptops, remote access software and cellphones, then sat at a Palo Alto coffee shop near Palantir’s headquarters, according to an affidavit.

headlines.title: Hakeem Jeffries’ progressive defectors reveal the limits of their power: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Seven incoming members of the House Democratic Caucus made their first big move since winning their elections this month, publicly stating that they voted against Hakeem Jeffries’ nomination to be the next speaker after a secret-ballot contest today.

headlines.title: Trump to hold one-on-one with Putin on the sidelines of Asia summit
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will hold a one-on-one meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday, a U.S. official confirmed, marking the leaders’ first in-person meeting in over a year.

headlines.title: House Democrat warns a dozen Trump allies to save their records, calling it ‘just the beginning’
headlines.description: Democratic Rep. Robert Garcia, who will chair the House Oversight Committee, sent 12 letters to associates of President Donald Trump to save their records ahead of investigations.
